senses.gloss:
खिद् I. €6 P. (खिन्दति, खिन्न) To strike, press down, afflict.
━II. €4. €7. Ā. (खिद्यते, खिन्त्ते, खिन्न) To suffer pain or misery,
 to be afflicted or wearied, feel tired, depressed or exhausted; Ś. 5. 7;
 स पुरुषो यः खिद्यते नेन्द्रियैः H. 2. 130; overpowered; किं नाम
 मयि खिद्यते गुरु Ve. 1; Śānti. 3. 7; Bk. 14. 108, 17. 10. ━Caus.
—1 To frighten, terrify.
—2 To exhaust, fatigue, make tired; ममानिमित्तानि हि खेदयन्ति Mk. 9. 10.

—1 An ascetic.
—2 A pauper.
—3 The moon.
—4 An epithet of Indra.

खिद्रः [खिद् दैन्ये रक्]
—1 A poor man, a pauper.
—2 Disease, sickness.
